summary: Revert of PR #510 (plugin host capture, d55ad8f6): with that plugin actually loaded by the OpenClaw 2026.10.9 Gateway, every typed samantha_* tool call was refused with typed_host_admission_required.
reason: S24 01/11 22:33 UTC, deploy 9862fd25 (first time the #510 plugin was really loaded: the earlier d55ad8f6 deploy never restarted the Gateway, whose in-memory pre-#510 plugin answered its owner_read): the parcours owner_read and write_recap failed with broken_reply; the recette transcript shows samantha_agenda agenda.event.read and agenda.event.create both returning state unverified, reason typed_host_admission_required. The typed invocation proof recorded by the before_tool_call hook was not found by the tool execute, consistent with the hook and the tool running in different module instances after the capture change. No write happened.
rollback: Re-apply PR #510 (revert this revert) only with a test proving that the before_tool_call hook and the typed tools share one module instance under the 2026.10.9 capture.
